regime_context: This is a narrow, one-narrative tape: Banks (rank 3) are the only high-durability, trend-eligible theme and the only crowded one, while the top momentum rank (Robotics & Automation) is ineligible and unscorable. The absolute-trend gate did NOT historically reduce drawdown on this market (mean-reverting), so even the headline eligibility signal is experimental here; cross-sectional rank is a focus lens only.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Robotics & Automation (rank 1, ineligible) regains trend-eligibility (durability_bar rising toward 0.6+ and hurst staying trend) AND scorable coverage appears; the observation that would retire this watch is either Robotics breadth dropping below 0.30 while Banks breadth stays above 0.75, or Robotics durability_bar climbing above 0.6 without any scorable proxy.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only scorable theme that is both trend-eligible and benefits from the one-narrative structure. Durability_bar of 0.76, hurst=trend, and breadth of 0.833 suggest the trend is internally coherent and broad-based, not a single-name drift. I lean overweight only because the gate_helps=false history warns that trend discipline has not cut drawdown on this market historically, so any tilt must be conditional on persistence.
evidence: one_narrative: true with 0.36 absorption (leadership not yet saturated)
theses.dissent: This market mean-reverts the absolute-trend gate, so the eligibility signal itself may be a whipsaw risk; crowding_z of 1.72 flags the trade as crowded, and a crowded one-narrative leader can reverse violently on any macro surprise (unscheduled_share is 1.0).

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is rank 2 by momentum score but ineligible, with low durability_bar (0.23), mixed hurst, and narrow breadth (0.30). This looks like a high-attention but fragile leadership signal, not a durable trend. Given gate_helps=false, ineligible themes in a mean-reverting tape are especially unreliable as long ideas.
theses.dissent: Coal could be an early cyclicals re-rating that the slow durability measure has not yet caught; its presence as rotation challenger to Robotics suggests some flow is trying to rotate into resources.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS closes up more than 8% on a rolling 10-day basis before 2026-11-25

theses.subject: Software & AI Apps
theses.thesis: Software & AI Apps shows the classic failed-narrative signature: mean-revert hurst, low durability (0.24), narrow breadth (0.267), and a negative score. In a tape where the one-narrative is Banks, this theme has no leadership support and is unscorable, so only a downside lean is defensible as a structural observation, not a momentum call.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst can also mean the theme is washed out and due for a bounce; absent a confirmed rotation catalyst, underweighting a low-rank theme in a mean-reverting market may just chase noise.
